title: When the Archive Burns
author: Astrid Delacroix
blurb: Coral Iversen, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
